decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures with abilities that trigger when they enter or leave the battlefield, often flickering them to generate value. It combines removal spells like Fatal Push and Solitude with powerful creatures like Phelia and Overlord of the Balemurk to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up a threatening board presence. Teferi, Time Raveler and Ephemerate provide additional disruption and protection for your creatures. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with quick and efficient threats while maintaining control of the battlefield.

This deck revolves around using mana ramp and creature tutor abilities to quickly assemble a powerful board presence, culminating in the ability to generate massive amounts of mana and cast powerful finishers like Craterhoof Behemoth and Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu. By utilizing a toolbox of creatures such as Devoted Druid, Fiend Artisan, and Vizier of Remedies, the deck is able to adapt to various situations and outvalue opponents. The Leyline of Abundance and Nature's Rhythm provide additional mana acceleration, while cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Finale of Devastation help to tutor for specific creatures when needed.

The deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and flicker effects to create value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Quantum Riddler and Flickerwisp, the deck can repeatedly exile and return creatures to the battlefield, triggering powerful abilities and maintaining board presence. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide disruption and removal to control the opponent's threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Solitude, while also generating card advantage with cards like Meticulous Archive and Consign to Memory.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly with cards like Ruby Medallion and Pyretic Ritual to cast powerful spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Grapeshot. The goal is to chain together spells using Past in Flames and Manamorphose to create a storm of spells that overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Desperate Ritual and Wish to further enable the combo potential. The mana base includes fetch lands to fix mana and maximize the chances of casting spells efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a burst of spellcasting.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures that have blink effects to continuously disrupt the opponent's board state and gain advantage. By using cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while maintaining pressure with efficient creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. The inclusion of disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push helps to control the pace of the game, while cards like Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional utility. The deck aims to outpace the opponent and overwhelm them with efficient threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards like Street Wraith and Faithless Looting to bring out powerful creatures like Hollow One and Vengevine early in the game. It also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. The inclusion of Burning Inquiry helps with card draw and potentially discarding key cards. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast creature drops and burn spells.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Solitude, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and hand disruption like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize. Atraxa, Grand Unifier provides additional utility and card advantage. The deck also includes Ephemerate and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect key pieces and ensure the combo goes off smoothly. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through a powerful and fast reanimation combo while controlling the opponent's resources.

This deck aims to ramp up mana quickly with Urza lands and Eldrazi Temple to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. The deck utilizes control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Chalice of the Void, Trinisphere, and Dismember provide additional control and removal options. The deck also includes cards like Expedition Map and Mind Stone for consistency and card advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game through powerful Eldrazi threats and disruption spells.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures with abilities that work well together to generate mana and pump out powerful threats. By using cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Agatha's Soul Cauldron, the player can tutor for specific creatures like Devoted Druid and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler to combo off and overwhelm the opponent with a Craterhoof Behemoth finisher. The Leyline of Abundance and Nature's Rhythm provide additional ramp and support for the creature-based strategy, allowing for explosive turns and resilient board presence.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures to create a powerful combo engine, utilizing cards like Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies to generate infinite mana and win the game with Walking Ballista or Finale of Devastation. The toolbox nature of the deck allows for flexibility in finding the right creature for any situation, while Leyline of Abundance and Green Sun's Zenith provide additional mana ramp and consistency. Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Badgermole Cub provide disruption and protection, making it a versatile and resilient combo deck in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on fast-paced aggression by combining cheap spells and aggressive creatures alongside disruption to keep the opponent off balance. Utilizing Monastery Swiftspear, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Cori-Steel Cutter, the deck looks to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. Thoughtseize provides hand disruption, while Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart can deal direct damage and take out threats. The goal is to maintain pressure and control the board early on to secure a victory before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing the UrzaTron lands to ramp up quickly and summon powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul and Ulamog. It also includes control elements such as Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Karn, the Great Creator can shut down artifacts and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon provides removal and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to control the game in the early turns while setting up for a game-winning play with its massive Eldrazi creatures.

This aggro Jeskai deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells to control the board while applying pressure to the opponent. Quantum Riddler and Guide of Souls provide card advantage and synergize with the deck's aggressive game plan. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah serves as a powerful finisher, while Solitude offers additional removal. The deck also includes some versatile spells like Ephemerate and Thraben Charm to deal with a variety of threats. The deck's mana base supports its three-color strategy, allowing for consistent casting of spells across all three colors.

This Modern deck focuses on using cycling creatures and cards like Street Wraith to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation to control the game until the combo can be executed. The key strategy is to cycle through the deck efficiently, using creatures with cycling abilities to set up a powerful Living End play that can overwhelm the opponent with a flood of creatures.

The deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blinking effects to disrupt the opponent's game plan and generate value. By using cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, you can repeatedly exile and return creatures like Solitude and Witch Enchanter, triggering powerful effects and controlling the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption in the form of cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to keep your opponent off balance. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while controlling the game through blinking and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes spells like Lava Dart, Lightning Bolt, and Violent Urge to control the board and push for lethal damage. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card selection and setting up the next turn's plays. The overall strategy is to apply constant pressure on the opponent and overwhelm them with fast, efficient threats. It aims to win the game quickly before the opponent can establish their own strategy.
